purpose: Horizontal lockup, left-aligned — chevron mark on the left edge, 智御无疆 + Kaup wordmark stack on the right. Designed for application headers, navigation bars, and any horizontal layout where the lockup should hug the left edge of its container (Apple / Nike / Stripe / Vercel / Linear convention).

sizes.1024w: large marketing headers, hero banners (1024×341 px)
sizes.512w: desktop app header / nav bar (512×170 px)
sizes.256w: compact header, mobile nav bar (256×85 px)
sizes.128w: footer watermark, small inline reference (128×43 px)

min_physical_size: 30mm width at 300dpi — below this the chevron stroke starts to feather
use_when: horizontal real-estate is available and the lockup should align to a left nav edge (default app header choice)
